changes.comment: refactor: remove global custom currency registry. Replace defineCurrency() with currency({ code, minorUnit }). Remove withMinor() — use money(amount, currency, { unit: 'minor' }). Remove resolveBuiltinCurrency — parseMoneyJSON defaults to currency(). isMoney/isCurrency/isExchangeRate now use WeakSet canonical identity (rejects forged frozen objects). Add isExchangeRate type guard. Add INVALID_RANGE and INVALID_EXCHANGE_RATE error codes. Fix divide() floor/ceil rounding with negative divisors. Add assertMoney to toJSON. Add roundDivision exhaustiveness default.
